retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for creating gritty, high-contrast hip-hop visuals featuring metallic, sharp-edged typography and layered photographic subjects with outer glows.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, layered composition featuring central figures in dynamic poses, flanked by larger, low-opacity ghosted portraits, all unified by a dark, smoky background and aggressive, chrome-textured typography with sharp, thorn-like extensions.
coreVisualRelationships: Central high-contrast figures anchored by a dark, atmospheric background
Large-scale metallic display text framing the top and bottom of the composition
Ghosted secondary portraits providing depth and scale variation
Outer glows and drop shadows separating foreground elements from the background
coreInvariants: Metallic or chrome texture on primary display typography
Sharp, thorn-like or spiked serifs on main title text
High-contrast lighting on human subjects with visible highlights
Dark, vignetted background with smoky or hazy textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subjects are centered and full-body or waist-up; secondary subjects are scaled up and placed at low opacity in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, metallic title at the top and the secondary title at the bottom create a vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top metallic title, moves down through the central figures, and rests on the bottom text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with figures, text, and atmospheric haze to create a dense, energetic feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark charcoal for background and shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and silver for highlights and metallic text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange or red glows behind central figures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between bright white clothing/text and deep black backgrounds; low saturation overall except for localized glows.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic base with limited warm accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sharp, aggressive serif and sans-serif mix
letterConstructionRules: Primary text features elongated, needle-sharp serifs and terminals
Letters are thick with a heavy 3D bevel or chrome effect
Secondary text is blocky, wide, and sans-serif for readability
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical strokes often extend into spikes
Crossbars may be angled or sharpened

composition.overlap: behind or in front of subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, custom metallic display type paired with clean, wide-set sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, aggressive, and decorative nature of the primary text
Matches the secondary blocky text at the bottom

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, smoky urban background with two central figures in white tank tops and dynamic poses. Add two larger, ghosted (low opacity) versions of their faces in the background corners. Use high-contrast lighting with a warm orange glow behind the central figures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, metallic-textured uppercase text with sharp, spiked serifs at the top and bottom. Ensure the text has a 3D bevel effect and a subtle outer glow to separate it from the dark background.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text metallic and spiked?
Are there ghosted portraits in the background?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?
Is the composition dense and centered?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the metallic chrome effect
Opacity of the ghosted background figures
Color of the atmospheric glow (orange, blue, or green)
mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure all text is original and not transcribed
postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic texture on display type
Verify presence of sharp, spiked serifs
Confirm high-contrast lighting on foreground subjects
Check for atmospheric smoke or haze effects
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Metallic Spiked Typography] + [High-Contrast Layered Portraits] + [Dark Smoky Background] + [Outer Glow Effects] to achieve the early 2000s southern rap aesthetic.
